Theme: biomedical discovery, from observing molecules to using AI in drug discovery. A luminous translucent folded protein-like structure with a sculptural colored ball-and-stick molecular model suspended close to a pocket in the foreground, a refined microscope softly out of focus behind it on a laboratory workbench. Deep teal, warm pearl, restrained amber light. Evocative scientific illustration without implying a specific actual drug. No people, no syringes, no medicine bottles, no medical claim.
